import 'package:adele_ui/capability_bridge.dart';
import 'package:adele_ui/main_content_bridge.dart';
import 'package:capability_probe_contract/contract.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

const capability = 'test.capability.read';

void initialize() {
  openMainContentPane('probe', 'Capability consumer', false);
}

Widget buildPane() => CapabilityProbe();

class CapabilityProbe extends StatefulWidget {
  @override
  State<CapabilityProbe> createState() => CapabilityProbeState();
}

class CapabilityProbeState extends State<CapabilityProbe> {
  String text = 'idle';
  String streamText = 'stream:idle';
  dynamic client;
  dynamic savedA;
  dynamic savedB;
  dynamic subscription;
  List<String> handles = [];
  bool disposed = false;

  void discover() {
    final providers = discoverCapabilityProviders(capability, 1);
    String result = 'providers';
    if (providers == null) {
      result = 'denied';
    } else {
      for (final provider in providers) {
        result =
            '$result|${provider['providerId']},${provider['pluginId']},${provider['displayName']},${provider['serviceId']}';
      }
    }
    setState(() {
      text = result;
    });
  }

  void select(String? provider) {
    final handle = resolveCapabilityProvider(
      capability,
      1,
      capabilityProbeServiceId,
      provider,
    );
    if (disposed) return;
    if (handle == null) {
      setState(() {
        text = 'selection:unavailable';
      });
      return;
    }
    handles.add(handle);
    client = CapabilityProbeServiceClient(CapabilityRequestChannel(handle));
    if (provider == 'test.provider.a') savedA = client;
    if (provider == 'test.provider.b') savedB = client;
    setState(() {
      text = 'selected';
    });
  }

  void read(dynamic selected, String scope) async {
    if (selected == null) return;
    final CapabilityProbeServiceClient typed = selected;
    final result = await settleCapabilityOperation(typed.read(scope));
    if (disposed) return;
    if (result[0] == true) {
      final ProbeValue value = result[1];
      setState(() {
        text =
            '${value.provider}:${value.configuration}:${value.sequence}:${value.text}';
      });
    } else {
      setState(() {
        text = 'read:unavailable';
      });
    }
  }

  void watch(String scope) {
    if (client == null) return;
    final CapabilityProbeServiceClient selected = client;
    setState(() {
      streamText = 'stream';
    });
    subscription = selected
        .watch(scope)
        .listen(
          (ProbeValue value) {
            setState(() {
              streamText =
                  '$streamText|${value.provider}:${value.configuration}:${value.sequence}:${value.text}';
            });
          },
          onError: (Object error) {
            setState(() {
              streamText = 'stream:error:$error';
            });
          },
          onDone: () {
            setState(() {
              streamText = '$streamText:done';
            });
          },
        );
  }

  void cancel() async {
    if (subscription == null) return;
    await subscription.cancel();
    if (!disposed)
      setState(() {
        streamText = 'stream:cancelled';
      });
  }

  void checkDenied() {
    final missing = discoverCapabilityProviders('test.capability.missing', 1);
    final version = discoverCapabilityProviders(capability, 2);
    final private = discoverCapabilityProviders('test.capability.private', 1);
    final undeclared = discoverCapabilityProviders(capability, 3);
    final wrongService = resolveCapabilityProvider(
      capability,
      1,
      'test.capability.private',
      null,
    );
    final wrongProvider = resolveCapabilityProvider(
      capability,
      1,
      capabilityProbeServiceId,
      'test.provider.missing',
    );
    final wrongVersion = resolveCapabilityProvider(
      capability,
      2,
      capabilityProbeServiceId,
      null,
    );
    final undeclaredHandle = resolveCapabilityProvider(
      capability,
      3,
      capabilityProbeServiceId,
      null,
    );
    final privateHandle = resolveCapabilityProvider(
      'test.capability.private',
      1,
      'test.capability.private',
      null,
    );
    final pass =
        missing != null &&
        missing.isEmpty &&
        version != null &&
        version.isEmpty &&
        private != null &&
        private.isEmpty &&
        undeclared == null &&
        wrongService == null &&
        wrongProvider == null &&
        wrongVersion == null &&
        undeclaredHandle == null &&
        privateHandle == null;
    setState(() {
      text = pass ? 'denials:passed' : 'denials:failed';
    });
  }

  void release() {
    bool released = false;
    for (final handle in handles) {
      if (releaseCapabilityProvider(handle)) released = true;
    }
    setState(() {
      text = released ? 'released' : 'already released';
    });
  }

  void overrideRoute() async {
    if (handles.isEmpty) return;
    final channel = CapabilityRequestChannel(handles.last);
    final result = await settleCapabilityOperation(
      channel.request('$capabilityProbeServiceId.read', <String, Object?>{
        'scope': 'normal',
        'serviceId': 'test.capability.private',
        'configurationContext': 'configured-b',
        'hostInvocationContext': 'forged',
      }),
    );
    if (disposed) return;
    setState(() {
      text = result[0] == false ? 'override:rejected' : 'override:accepted';
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    disposed = true;
    if (subscription != null) subscription.cancel();
    for (final handle in handles) {
      releaseCapabilityProvider(handle);
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Column(
    children: [
      Text(text),
      Text(streamText),
      Column(
        children: [
          TextButton(onPressed: discover, child: Text('Discover')),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              select(null);
            },
            child: Text('Default'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              select('test.provider.a');
            },
            child: Text('Select A'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              select('test.provider.b');
            },
            child: Text('Select B'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              read(client, 'normal');
            },
            child: Text('Read'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              read(savedA, 'normal');
            },
            child: Text('Read saved A'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              read(savedB, 'normal');
            },
            child: Text('Read saved B'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              read(client, 'held');
            },
            child: Text('Held'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              read(client, 'fail');
            },
            child: Text('Fail'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              watch('bounded');
            },
            child: Text('Watch bounded'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              watch('gated');
            },
            child: Text('Watch gated'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              watch('fail');
            },
            child: Text('Watch failure'),
          ),
          TextButton(onPressed: cancel, child: Text('Cancel')),
          TextButton(onPressed: checkDenied, child: Text('Check denials')),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              read(
                CapabilityProbeServiceClient(
                  CapabilityRequestChannel('test.provider.a'),
                ),
                'normal',
              );
            },
            child: Text('Forged handle'),
          ),
          TextButton(onPressed: release, child: Text('Release')),
          TextButton(onPressed: overrideRoute, child: Text('Override route')),
        ],
      ),
    ],
  );
}
